Details of the Onboarding Process

This document describes the standard onboarding process (so called Future Onboarding Process - FOP).

Note: In the embedded image the following relabels apply:

  • DCCG -> TNG

  • CSCA -> SCA

  • DCC -> VDHC (Verifiable Digital Health Certificate)

  • NB -> TNP

It is highly recommended:

  • To use certificates issued from a public CA which follows the CAB Forum Rules

  • Not to reuse any certificates across the different staging environments

In the following description the required steps are divided into three sections:

[1] - [29] - Application and Verification
[30] - [59] Setup
[60] - [End] Participant Onboarding

head.prose:
#### The Onboarding Process as BPMN

The onboarding process is also drawn in BPMN 2.0, in `input/business-processes/`. Where the drawing below and the text differ, the text is authority: the GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework first, then the step text on this page. Each task names its step numbers **[n]** and Framework sections in its documentation.

Three pools take part: the GDHCN Participant, the GDHCN Secretariat (WHO), and the gateway operator (the operations and onboarding teams, with the GitHub bot as service tasks). The environment (UAT, PROD, and DEV if used) is a parameter of each subprocess, so each subprocess is drawn once.

| Process | What it does | Steps on this page | Framework |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GDHCN.ONB` | Onboard a Participant (top level) | [1]-[80] | V.4, VI.5, IX |
| `GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys` | Prepare keys and repository, per environment | [9]-[13] | V.4.c, VII.4-5, IX |
| `GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter` | Verify the Letter of Application | [15]-[23] | V.4.a-b, IX |
| `GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys` | Register the keys, per environment | [31]-[50] | VI.6 |
| `GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest` | Connect and test, per environment | [43]-[46], [60]-[76] | IX |
| `GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose` | Propose a new Trust Domain | not on the drawing | V.3, VI.2-3, XI |
| `GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join` | Join a further Trust Domain | not on the drawing | V.4, IX |
| `GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys` | Change keys or representatives | not on the drawing | IX |
| `GDHCN.ONB.Terminate` | End participation | not on the drawing | XV.1-3 |

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Change keys or representatives after onboarding. Framework IX. Not drawn on the page.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Tech" name="Technical change" sourceRef="C.Tech" targetRef="CS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Rep" name="New representatives" sourceRef="C.Rep" targetRef="CS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Keys" name="New keys" sourceRef="CS.Handover" targetRef="CO2.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant" name="Report a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.What</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Tech</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Rep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.Start" name="Keys or representatives change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX, last paragraphs.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_98</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.What" name="What changed?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX distinguishes technical changes from changes of representatives.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_98</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_99</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.Tech" name="Send the technical change by secure channel">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes needed to establish trust must use the same secure channels, or others the Secretariat identifies.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_99</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_101</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.Rep" name="Notify the change of representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: notify the Secretariat in a timely manner.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_102</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_101</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_102</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_103</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.End" name="Change notified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_103</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_98" sourceRef="C.Start" targetRef="C.What" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_99" name="keys" sourceRef="C.What" targetRef="C.Tech" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_100" name="representatives" sourceRef="C.What" targetRef="C.Rep" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_101" sourceRef="C.Tech" targetRef="C.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_102" sourceRef="C.Rep" targetRef="C.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_103" sourceRef="C.Merge" targetRef="C.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CS.Start" name="Change received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_104</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CS.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CS.Verify" name="Verify the change">
      <bpmn:documentation>As in GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter, steps [18]-[22], for the changed items.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_104</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_105</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CS.Keys" name="Keys changed?" default="Flow_CS_keys_no">
      <bpmn:documentation>Only key changes go to the operator.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_105</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_106</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CS_keys_no</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CS.Handover" name="Send the new keys to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_106</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_107</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CS.Record" name="Update the contact records">
      <bpmn:documentation>The representatives named for the Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CS_keys_no</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_108</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CS.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_107</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_108</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_109</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CS.End" name="Change recorded">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_109</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_104" sourceRef="CS.Start" targetRef="CS.Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_105" sourceRef="CS.Verify" targetRef="CS.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_106" name="yes" sourceRef="CS.Keys" targetRef="CS.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CS_keys_no" name="no" sourceRef="CS.Keys" targetRef="CS.Record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_107" sourceRef="CS.Handover" targetRef="CS.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_108" sourceRef="CS.Record" targetRef="CS.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_109" sourceRef="CS.Merge" targetRef="CS.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.Reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CO2.Start" name="New keys received">

    <bpmn:callActivity id="CO2.Reg" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Change keys or representatives after onboarding. Framework IX. Not drawn on the page.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Tech" name="Technical change" sourceRef="C.Tech" targetRef="CS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Rep" name="New representatives" sourceRef="C.Rep" targetRef="CS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Keys" name="New keys" sourceRef="CS.Handover" targetRef="CO2.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant" name="Report a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.What</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Tech</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Rep</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.Start" name="Keys or representatives change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX, last paragraphs.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_98</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.What" name="What changed?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX distinguishes technical changes from changes of representatives.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_98</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_99</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.Tech" name="Send the technical change by secure channel">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes needed to establish trust must use the same secure channels, or others the Secretariat identifies.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_99</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_101</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.Rep" name="Notify the change of representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: notify the Secretariat in a timely manner.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_102</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_101</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_102</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_103</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.End" name="Change notified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_103</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_98" sourceRef="C.Start" targetRef="C.What" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_99" name="keys" sourceRef="C.What" targetRef="C.Tech" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_100" name="representatives" sourceRef="C.What" targetRef="C.Rep" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_101" sourceRef="C.Tech" targetRef="C.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_102" sourceRef="C.Rep" targetRef="C.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_103" sourceRef="C.Merge" targetRef="C.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CS.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CS.Start" name="Change received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_104</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CS.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CS.Verify" name="Verify the change">
      <bpmn:documentation>As in GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter, steps [18]-[22], for the changed items.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_104</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_105</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CS.Keys" name="Keys changed?" default="Flow_CS_keys_no">
      <bpmn:documentation>Only key changes go to the operator.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_105</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_106</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CS_keys_no</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CS.Handover" name="Send the new keys to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_106</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_107</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CS.Record" name="Update the contact records">
      <bpmn:documentation>The representatives named for the Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CS_keys_no</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_108</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CS.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_107</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_108</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_109</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CS.End" name="Change recorded">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_109</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_104" sourceRef="CS.Start" targetRef="CS.Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_105" sourceRef="CS.Verify" targetRef="CS.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_106" name="yes" sourceRef="CS.Keys" targetRef="CS.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CS_keys_no" name="no" sourceRef="CS.Keys" targetRef="CS.Record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_107" sourceRef="CS.Handover" targetRef="CS.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_108" sourceRef="CS.Record" targetRef="CS.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_109" sourceRef="CS.Merge" targetRef="CS.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator" name="Register changed keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[50] again.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Operator.Lane" name="Gateway operator">
        <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.Reg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO2.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CO2.Start" name="New keys received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_110</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CO2.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CO2.Reg" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys">
      <bpmn:documentation>GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys for each changed environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_110</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_111</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CO2.End" name="New keys live">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_111</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_110" sourceRef="CO2.Start" targetRef="CO2.Reg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_111" sourceRef="CO2.Reg" targetRef="CO2.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Connect to the gateway and test, for one environment. Steps [43]-[46], [60]-[76]. The page names the onboarding team for UAT [64] and the service provider for PROD [75]; both are the gateway operator here.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Info" name="Connection information" sourceRef="CO.Inform" targetRef="CP.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.C.Res" name="Test results" sourceRef="CP.Send" targetRef="CO.Recv" />

    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_75</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CP_conn_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_76</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CP.Fix" name="Correct the connection with the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [61] and [71]: the operations team supports the Participant.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_76</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_77</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CP.Test" name="Run the test">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [62]: the UAT dry run test. Step [72]: the Production Readiness Test.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CP_conn_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_81</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_78</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CP.Send" name="Send the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [63] and [73], by email.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_78</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_79</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="CP.Recv" name="Receive the check result">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_79</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_80</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CP.Ok" name="Passed?" default="Flow_CP_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Did the test pass?</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_80</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CP_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_81</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CP.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CP_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_74" sourceRef="CP.Start" targetRef="CP.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_75" sourceRef="CP.Connect" targetRef="CP.Conn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CP_conn_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="CP.Conn" targetRef="CP.Test" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_76" name="no" sourceRef="CP.Conn" targetRef="CP.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_77" sourceRef="CP.Fix" targetRef="CP.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_78" sourceRef="CP.Test" targetRef="CP.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_79" sourceRef="CP.Send" targetRef="CP.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_80" sourceRef="CP.Recv" targetRef="CP.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CP_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="CP.Ok" targetRef="CP.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_81" name="no, after correction" sourceRef="CP.Ok" targetRef="CP.Test" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator" name="Whitelist and check the test" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43]-[46], [64]-[69], [74]-[76].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Operator.Lane" name="Gateway operator">
        <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.White</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Inform</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Recv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.Pass</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CO.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CO.Start" name="Keys registered">
      <bpmn:documentation>Input: the environment (UAT or PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_66</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="CO.White" name="Whitelist the certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43] (UAT) and [67] (PROD, after the dry run passed).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_66</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_67</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CO.Inform" name="Send the connection information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [44]-[45] and [68].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_67</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_68</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="CO.Recv" name="Receive the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [64] and [74].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_68</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_72</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_69</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CO.Check" name="Check the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_69</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_70</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CO.Ok" name="Passed?" default="Flow_CO_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Did the test pass?</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_70</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CO_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_71</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CO.Fix" name="Agree corrective actions">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [66] and [76].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_71</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_72</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CO.Pass" name="Send the result">
      <bpmn:documentation>The test passed.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CO_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_73</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CO.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation>UAT: go on to PROD. PROD: step [77].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_73</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_66" sourceRef="CO.Start" targetRef="CO.White" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_67" sourceRef="CO.White" targetRef="CO.Inform" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_68" sourceRef="CO.Inform" targetRef="CO.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_69" sourceRef="CO.Recv" targetRef="CO.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_70" sourceRef="CO.Check" targetRef="CO.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CO_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="CO.Ok" targetRef="CO.Pass" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_71" name="no" sourceRef="CO.Ok" targetRef="CO.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_72" sourceRef="CO.Fix" targetRef="CO.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_73" sourceRef="CO.Pass" targetRef="CO.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

head.prose:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the keys and repository for one environment. Steps [9]-[13].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.K.Invite" name="Bot invitation" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="Secretariat" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.K.Accept" name="Invitation accepted" sourceRef="Secretariat" targetRef="K.Accept" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant" name="Prepare keys and repository" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13]. Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Certs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Gpg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Repo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Publish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Invite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Expired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="K.Start" name="Invitation received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [8]. Input: the environment (UAT, PROD, or DEV).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[11] can run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Certs" name="Create TLS, UP and SCA certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [9], for the environment. See concepts_CertificatePreperation. Framework VII.4.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Gpg" name="Create GPG keys for each user">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [10], for the environment and each authorised person, as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes. Framework IX and the Letter of Application: a key compliant with RFC 4880.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Repo" name="Create a private GitHub repository">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [11], one for the environment. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>All three are ready.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Publish" name="Put public keys in the repository and sign a tag">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9] and [11], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="K.Invite" name="Invite the GitHub bot user">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [11]-[12]: the bot user for the environment named in concepts_onboarding_checklist.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_36</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="K.Accept" name="Receive the acceptance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13]: WHO must accept within 7 days.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="K.Expired" name="7 days passed" attachedToRef="K.Accept" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12]: the invitation loses validity after 7 days.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_36</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="K.Expired.Def"><bpmn:timeDuration>P7D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="K.End" name="Keys and repository ready">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the keys and repository for one environment. Steps [9]-[13].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.K.Invite" name="Bot invitation" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="Secretariat" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.K.Accept" name="Invitation accepted" sourceRef="Secretariat" targetRef="K.Accept" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant" name="Prepare keys and repository" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13]. Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Certs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Gpg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Repo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Publish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Invite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Expired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="K.Start" name="Invitation received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [8]. Input: the environment (UAT, PROD, or DEV).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[11] can run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Certs" name="Create TLS, UP and SCA certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [9], for the environment. See concepts_CertificatePreperation. Framework VII.4.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Gpg" name="Create GPG keys for each user">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [10], for the environment and each authorised person, as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes. Framework IX and the Letter of Application: a key compliant with RFC 4880.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Repo" name="Create a private GitHub repository">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [11], one for the environment. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>All three are ready.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Publish" name="Put public keys in the repository and sign a tag">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9] and [11], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="K.Invite" name="Invite the GitHub bot user">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [11]-[12]: the bot user for the environment named in concepts_onboarding_checklist.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_36</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="K.Accept" name="Receive the acceptance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13]: WHO must accept within 7 days.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="K.Expired" name="7 days passed" attachedToRef="K.Accept" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12]: the invitation loses validity after 7 days.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_36</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="K.Expired.Def"><bpmn:timeDuration>P7D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="K.End" name="Keys and repository ready">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for the Letter of Application, step [14].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_35</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="K.Start" targetRef="K.Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Certs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Gpg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Repo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="K.Certs" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="K.Gpg" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="K.Repo" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="K.Join" targetRef="K.Publish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="K.Publish" targetRef="K.Invite" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="K.Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="K.Accept" targetRef="K.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="K.Expired" targetRef="K.Invite" />
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Register the Participant keys for one environment. Steps [31]-[50].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.R.Ask" name="PR to sign" sourceRef="R.AskWho" targetRef="Secretariat" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.R.Sig" name="Signature" sourceRef="Secretariat" targetRef="R.Signed" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.R.Fb" name="Verification failed" sourceRef="R.Fb" targetRef="Participant" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.R.Fix" name="Correction" sourceRef="Participant" targetRef="R.Fixed" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator" name="Register the keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[50]. Framework VI.6 (WHO as trust anchor signs PROD keys).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Operator.Lane" name="Gateway operator">
        <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Config</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Pr</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Env</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Auto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.AskWho</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.Signed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Verify one Letter of Application. Steps [15]-[23]. Framework V.4.a-b, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="Participant" targetRef="V.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Fail" name="Validation failed" sourceRef="V.Fail" targetRef="Participant" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Fix" name="Corrected Letter" sourceRef="Participant" targetRef="V.Corrected" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat" name="Verify the Letter of Application" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [15]-[23].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Office</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Wha</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Corrected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Email</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Crit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="V.Start" name="Letter of Application received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [15]. One Letter for each Trust Domain. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_37</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="V.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX names two secure channels; page [16]-[17].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_37</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_38</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_39</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Office" name="Meet in person, then diplomatic pouch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: a face-to-face meeting of an authorised WHO staff member or the WHO Country Representative with the Legal or Business Owner Representative, with identity confirmed by passport; the Letter then goes by diplomatic pouch to WHO Headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_38</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_40</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Wha" name="Meet a delegate at a governing body">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: a face-to-face meeting with an official delegate at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting, with identity confirmed by passport.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_39</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_41</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Letter has arrived through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_40</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_41</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_42</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Check" name="Verify accuracy, eligibility and rules">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [18]. Framework V.4.a, IX ("verify the accuracy and eligibility of the applicant").</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_42</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_46</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_43</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Ok" name="Compliant?" default="Flow_V_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Did the rules verification pass? Step [19].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_43</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_V_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_44</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="V.Fail" name="Inform the Participant of the failure">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [19], by email.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_44</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_45</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="V.Corrected" name="Receive the corrected Letter">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [20]: the Participant takes corrective action.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_45</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_46</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="V.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>The two key checks run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_V_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_47</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_48</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Email" name="Check each GPG key holds its email">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [21].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_47</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_49</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Crit" name="Check the GPG key against the criteria">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [22]: the key meets the criteria in concepts_certificate_governance and the Letter of Application (RFC 4880; Framework IX), and its email matches the Letter.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_48</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_50</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="V.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Both checks done.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_49</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_50</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_51</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Collect" name="Collect information for the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [23]: the GPG keys, repository URLs, the 3-letter ISO code, and the confirmation that the bot invitation was accepted.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_51</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_52</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="V.End" name="Letter verified">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for hand-over, step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_52</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="V.Start" targetRef="V.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" name="in-country" sourceRef="V.Channel" targetRef="V.Office" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" name="governing body" sourceRef="V.Channel" targetRef="V.Wha" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="V.Office" targetRef="V.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" sourceRef="V.Wha" targetRef="V.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" sourceRef="V.Merge" targetRef="V.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="V.Check" targetRef="V.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="V.Ok" targetRef="V.Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" name="no" sourceRef="V.Ok" targetRef="V.Fail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_45" sourceRef="V.Fail" targetRef="V.Corrected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_46" sourceRef="V.Corrected" targetRef="V.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_47" sourceRef="V.Split" targetRef="V.Email" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_48" sourceRef="V.Split" targetRef="V.Crit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_49" sourceRef="V.Email" targetRef="V.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_50" sourceRef="V.Crit" targetRef="V.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_51" sourceRef="V.Join" targetRef="V.Collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_52" sourceRef="V.Collect" targetRef="V.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="Participant" targetRef="V.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Fail" name="Validation failed" sourceRef="V.Fail" targetRef="Participant" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.V.Fix" name="Corrected Letter" sourceRef="Participant" targetRef="V.Corrected" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat" name="Verify the Letter of Application" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [15]-[23].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Office</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Wha</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Corrected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Email</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Crit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.Collect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="V.Start" name="Letter of Application received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [15]. One Letter for each Trust Domain. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_37</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="V.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX names two secure channels; page [16]-[17].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_37</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_38</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_39</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Office" name="Meet in person, then diplomatic pouch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: a face-to-face meeting of an authorised WHO staff member or the WHO Country Representative with the Legal or Business Owner Representative, with identity confirmed by passport; the Letter then goes by diplomatic pouch to WHO Headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_38</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_40</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Wha" name="Meet a delegate at a governing body">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: a face-to-face meeting with an official delegate at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting, with identity confirmed by passport.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_39</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_41</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Letter has arrived through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_40</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_41</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_42</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Check" name="Verify accuracy, eligibility and rules">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [18]. Framework V.4.a, IX ("verify the accuracy and eligibility of the applicant").</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_42</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_46</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_43</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.Ok" name="Compliant?" default="Flow_V_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Did the rules verification pass? Step [19].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_43</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_V_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_44</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="V.Fail" name="Inform the Participant of the failure">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [19], by email.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_44</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_45</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="V.Corrected" name="Receive the corrected Letter">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [20]: the Participant takes corrective action.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_45</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_46</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="V.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>The two key checks run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_V_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_47</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_48</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Email" name="Check each GPG key holds its email">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [21].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_47</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_49</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Crit" name="Check the GPG key against the criteria">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [22]: the key meets the criteria in concepts_certificate_governance and the Letter of Application (RFC 4880; Framework IX), and its email matches the Letter.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_48</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_50</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="V.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Both checks done.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_49</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_50</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_51</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.Collect" name="Collect information for the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [23]: the GPG keys, repository URLs, the 3-letter ISO code, and the confirmation that the bot invitation was accepted.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_51</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_52</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="V.End" name="Letter verified">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for hand-over, step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_52</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="V.Start" targetRef="V.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" name="in-country" sourceRef="V.Channel" targetRef="V.Office" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" name="governing body" sourceRef="V.Channel" targetRef="V.Wha" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="V.Office" targetRef="V.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" sourceRef="V.Wha" targetRef="V.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" sourceRef="V.Merge" targetRef="V.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="V.Check" targetRef="V.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_V_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="V.Ok" targetRef="V.Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" name="no" sourceRef="V.Ok" targetRef="V.Fail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_45" sourceRef="V.Fail" targetRef="V.Corrected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_46" sourceRef="V.Corrected" targetRef="V.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_47" sourceRef="V.Split" targetRef="V.Email" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_48" sourceRef="V.Split" targetRef="V.Crit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_49" sourceRef="V.Email" targetRef="V.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_50" sourceRef="V.Crit" targetRef="V.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_51" sourceRef="V.Join" targetRef="V.Collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_52" sourceRef="V.Collect" targetRef="V.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Diagram">

head.prose:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Onboard a GDHCN Participant to a Trust Domain. Framework V.4, VI.5, IX; page concepts_onboarding_process_full. Three subprocesses carry the detail; the environment (UAT, PROD) is a parameter of each.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Interest" name="Statement of Interest" sourceRef="P.SendInterest" targetRef="S.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Reject" name="Rejection" sourceRef="S.Reject" targetRef="P.RecvResult" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Invite" name="Invitation and technical information" sourceRef="S.Invite" targetRef="P.RecvResult" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="P.SendLetter" targetRef="S.Verify" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Handover" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="S.Handover" targetRef="O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Ready" name="Production Readiness confirmed" sourceRef="O.Confirm" targetRef="S.RecvReady" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Done" name="Onboarding confirmation" sourceRef="O.Confirm" targetRef="P.RecvDone" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant" name="Join the GDHCN" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Participant side of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.SendInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.RecvResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Invited</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Modify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.SendLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.TestUAT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.TestPROD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.RecvDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="P.Start" name="Decided to join the GDHCN">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant determines which Trust Domains it intends to participate in. Framework VII.1.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="P.SendInterest" name="Send Statement of Interest">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [1]. Sent to gdhcn-support@who.int.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="P.RecvResult" name="Receive the result of the check">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [5] and [8]: a rejection by email, or an invitation with the technical information.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="P.Invited" name="Invited?" default="Flow_P_inv_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Was the Participant invited to start onboarding? Step [7].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P_inv_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="P.Modify" name="Modify the data and re-apply">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [6].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.Prepare" name="Prepare keys and repository" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13], once for each environment (UAT, PROD, and DEV if used). Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P_inv_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="P.SendLetter" name="Send the signed Letter of Application">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [14]. One officially signed Letter for each Trust Domain, conveyed through a secure channel. Framework V.4, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.TestUAT" name="Connect and test in UAT" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60]-[63]: connect and run the dry run test. Environment = UAT. Framework IX (user acceptance testing).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.TestPROD" name="Connect and test in PROD" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [70]-[73]: connect and run the Production Readiness Test. Environment = PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
