head.html:
<pre><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Onboard a GDHCN Participant to a Trust Domain. Framework V.4, VI.5, IX; page concepts_onboarding_process_full. Three subprocesses carry the detail; the environment (UAT, PROD) is a parameter of each.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Interest" name="Statement of Interest" sourceRef="P.SendInterest" targetRef="S.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Reject" name="Rejection" sourceRef="S.Reject" targetRef="P.RecvResult" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Invite" name="Invitation and technical information" sourceRef="S.Invite" targetRef="P.RecvResult" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="P.SendLetter" targetRef="S.Verify" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Handover" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="S.Handover" targetRef="O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Ready" name="Production Readiness confirmed" sourceRef="O.Confirm" targetRef="S.RecvReady" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.Done" name="Onboarding confirmation" sourceRef="O.Confirm" targetRef="P.RecvDone" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant" name="Join the GDHCN" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Participant side of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.SendInterest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.RecvResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Invited</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Modify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.Prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.SendLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.TestUAT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.TestPROD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.RecvDone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="P.Start" name="Decided to join the GDHCN">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant determines which Trust Domains it intends to participate in. Framework VII.1.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="P.SendInterest" name="Send Statement of Interest">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [1]. Sent to gdhcn-support@who.int.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="P.RecvResult" name="Receive the result of the check">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [5] and [8]: a rejection by email, or an invitation with the technical information.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="P.Invited" name="Invited?" default="Flow_P_inv_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Was the Participant invited to start onboarding? Step [7].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P_inv_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="P.Modify" name="Modify the data and re-apply">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [6].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.Prepare" name="Prepare keys and repository" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13], once for each environment (UAT, PROD, and DEV if used). Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P_inv_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="P.SendLetter" name="Send the signed Letter of Application">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [14]. One officially signed Letter for each Trust Domain, conveyed through a secure channel. Framework V.4, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.TestUAT" name="Connect and test in UAT" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60]-[63]: connect and run the dry run test. Environment = UAT. Framework IX (user acceptance testing).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="P.TestPROD" name="Connect and test in PROD" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [70]-[73]: connect and run the Production Readiness Test. Environment = PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="P.RecvDone" name="Receive the onboarding confirmation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [77]: the confirmation email that the Production Readiness Test passed.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="P.End" name="Onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78]: the Participant may use the TNG PROD environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="P.Start" targetRef="P.SendInterest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="P.SendInterest" targetRef="P.RecvResult" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="P.RecvResult" targetRef="P.Invited" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_inv_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="P.Invited" targetRef="P.Prepare" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="no" sourceRef="P.Invited" targetRef="P.Modify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="P.Modify" targetRef="P.SendInterest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="P.Prepare" targetRef="P.SendLetter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="P.SendLetter" targetRef="P.TestUAT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="P.TestUAT" targetRef="P.TestPROD" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="P.TestPROD" targetRef="P.RecvDone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="P.RecvDone" targetRef="P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat" name="Oversee onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Secretariat side of onboarding. Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Invite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.RecvReady</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.Monitor</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="S.Start" name="Statement of Interest received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [1].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="S.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S.Check" name="Validate data and Terms of Participation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [2]-[3]: eligibility criteria, governmental entity or health agency, contacts, and the Terms of Participation. Framework V.4.a, VIII.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="S.Ok" name="Compliant?" default="Flow_S_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Does the application comply with the governance rules? Step [4].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S.Reject" name="Reject by email">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [4]-[5].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="S.Rejected" name="Application rejected">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [5]. The Participant may re-apply (step [6]).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S.Invite" name="Invite to start onboarding">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [7]: technical specifications, configuration information, the environments, and the request to comply with the Terms of Participation.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="S.Verify" name="Verify the Letter of Application" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [15]-[23]. Framework V.4.a-b, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="S.Handover" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30]: the collected information of step [23]. The onboarding team is informed as well.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="S.RecvReady" name="Receive the readiness confirmation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [77]: the confirmation that the Production Readiness Test passed.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="S.Monitor" name="Record the Participant as onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [79]-[80]: the Participant is listed as onboarded for the Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="S.End" name="Onboarding overseen">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="S.Start" targetRef="S.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="S.Check" targetRef="S.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="S.Ok" targetRef="S.Invite" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="no" sourceRef="S.Ok" targetRef="S.Reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="S.Reject" targetRef="S.Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="S.Invite" targetRef="S.Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="S.Verify" targetRef="S.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="S.Handover" targetRef="S.RecvReady" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="S.RecvReady" targetRef="S.Monitor" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="S.Monitor" targetRef="S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator" name="Set up the gateway" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The operator side of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Operator.Lane" name="Gateway operator">
        <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.Register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.TestUAT</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.TestPROD</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.Confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="O.Register" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[50], once for each environment (UAT, PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="O.TestUAT" name="Whitelist and test in UAT" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43]-[46] and [64]-[66]. Environment = UAT.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="O.TestPROD" name="Whitelist and test in PROD" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [67]-[69] and [74]-[76]. Environment = PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="O.Confirm" name="Confirm Production Readiness">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [77]: email to the Participant and to WHO.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="O.End" name="Participant live in PROD">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="O.Start" targetRef="O.Register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="O.Register" targetRef="O.TestUAT" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="O.TestUAT" targetRef="O.TestPROD" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="O.TestPROD" targetRef="O.Confirm" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="O.Confirm" targetRef="O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.Diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="GDHCN.ONB.Plane" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant_di" bpmnElement="Participant" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="60" width="2620" height="280" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant.Lane_di" bpmnElement="Participant.Lane" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="60" width="2590" height="280" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Secretariat_di" bpmnElement="Secretariat" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="370" width="2620" height="280" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Secretariat.Lane_di" bpmnElement="Secretariat.Lane" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="370" width="2590" height="280" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Operator_di" bpmnElement="Operator" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="680" width="2620" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Operator.Lane_di" bpmnElement="Operator.Lane" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="680" width="2590" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.Start_di" bpmnElement="P.Start"><dc:Bounds x="292" y="117" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.SendInterest_di" bpmnElement="P.SendInterest"><dc:Bounds x="420" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.RecvResult_di" bpmnElement="P.RecvResult"><dc:Bounds x="610" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.Invited_di" bpmnElement="P.Invited" isMarkerVisible="true"><dc:Bounds x="855" y="110" width="50" height="50" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.Modify_di" bpmnElement="P.Modify"><dc:Bounds x="800" y="225" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.Prepare_di" bpmnElement="P.Prepare" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="990" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.SendLetter_di" bpmnElement="P.SendLetter"><dc:Bounds x="1180" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.TestUAT_di" bpmnElement="P.TestUAT" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="1560" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.TestPROD_di" bpmnElement="P.TestPROD" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="1750" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.RecvDone_di" bpmnElement="P.RecvDone"><dc:Bounds x="1940" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="P.End_di" bpmnElement="P.End"><dc:Bounds x="2192" y="117" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="S.Start_di" bpmnElement="S.Start"><dc:Bounds x="482" y="427" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="S.Check_di" bpmnElement="S.Check"><dc:Bounds x="610" y="405" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Join a further Trust Domain once onboarded. Framework V.4, IX. Not drawn on the page.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Operator" name="Gateway operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operations (OPS) and onboarding (OB) teams of the service provider that runs the Trust Network Gateway, with the GitHub bot (tng-bot, tng-bot-dev) as its service tasks. Page [30]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.J" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="J.Letter" targetRef="JS.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant" name="Join a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.Start" name="Wants a further Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>An onboarded GDHCN Participant decides to join another Trust Domain. Framework VII.1, V.4 ("one or more Trust Domains").</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_92</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="J.Letter" name="Send a Letter of Application for it">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: one officially signed Letter for each Trust Domain, through a secure channel, on the Annex form of that Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_92</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_93</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.Test" name="Connect and test" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.b-c: technical specifications and Trusted Services of the Trust Domain; user acceptance testing (IX).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_93</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_94</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.End" name="Joined the Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_94</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_92" sourceRef="J.Start" targetRef="J.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_93" sourceRef="J.Letter" targetRef="J.Test" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_94" sourceRef="J.Test" targetRef="J.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat" name="Admit to a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>JS.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>JS.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>JS.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>JS.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="JS.Start" name="Letter received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_95</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="JS.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="JS.Verify" name="Verify the Letter of Application" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.a-b, IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_95</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_96</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="JS.Handover" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30] of GDHCN.ONB, for the new Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_96</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_97</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="JS.End" name="Handed over">
      <bpmn:documentation>The operator registers keys and tests as in GDHCN.ONB.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_97</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_95" sourceRef="JS.Start" targetRef="JS.Verify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_96" sourceRef="JS.Verify" targetRef="JS.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_97" sourceRef="JS.Handover" targetRef="JS.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Plane" bpmnElement="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Collaboration">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant_di" bpmnElement="Participant" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="60" width="1290" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant.Lane_di" bpmnElement="Participant.Lane" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="60" width="1260" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Secretariat_di" bpmnElement="Secretariat" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="240" width="1290" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Secretariat.Lane_di" bpmnElement="Secretariat.Lane" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="240" width="1260" height="150" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Operator_di" bpmnElement="Operator" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="420" width="1290" height="70" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="J.Start_di" bpmnElement="J.Start"><dc:Bounds x="292" y="117" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="J.Letter_di" bpmnElement="J.Letter"><dc:Bounds x="420" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="J.Test_di" bpmnElement="J.Test" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="990" y="95" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="J.End_di" bpmnElement="J.End"><dc:Bounds x="1242" y="117" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="JS.Start_di" bpmnElement="JS.Start"><dc:Bounds x="482" y="297" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="JS.Verify_di" bpmnElement="JS.Verify" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="610" y="275" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="JS.Handover_di" bpmnElement="JS.Handover"><dc:Bounds x="800" y="275" width="160" height="80" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="JS.End_di" bpmnElement="JS.End"><dc:Bounds x="1052" y="297" width="36" height="36" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_92_di" bpmnElement="Flow_92"><di:waypoint x="328" y="135" /><di:waypoint x="420" y="135" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_93_di" bpmnElement="Flow_93"><di:waypoint x="580" y="135" /><di:waypoint x="990" y="135" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_94_di" bpmnElement="Flow_94"><di:waypoint x="1150" y="135" /><di:waypoint x="1242" y="135" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_95_di" bpmnElement="Flow_95"><di:waypoint x="518" y="315" /><di:waypoint x="610" y="315" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_96_di" bpmnElement="Flow_96"><di:waypoint x="770" y="315" /><di:waypoint x="800" y="315" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Flow_97_di" bpmnElement="Flow_97"><di:waypoint x="960" y="315" /><di:waypoint x="1052" y="315" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="Msg.J_di" bpmnElement="Msg.J"><di:waypoint x="500" y="175" /><di:waypoint x="500" y="297" /></bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Propose a new Trust Domain. Framework V.3, VI.2-3, X, XI. Not drawn on the page.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (the page calls it the Trust Network Participant, TNP). Framework VII.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Secretariat">

    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.TP" name="Trust Domain proposal" sourceRef="TP.Send" targetRef="TS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.TP.Yes" name="Annex published" sourceRef="TS.Publish" targetRef="TP.Recv" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Msg.TP.No" name="Not approved" sourceRef="TS.No" targetRef="TP.Recv" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant" name="Propose a Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Participant.Lane" name="GDHCN Participant">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Draft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Recv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="TP.Start" name="Need for a new Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3: one or more Eligible GDHCN Participants may propose a Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_82</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TP.Draft" name="Describe the proposed Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3: use cases, technical specifications, and policy and regulatory standards.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_82</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_83</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TP.Send" name="Propose it to the Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_83</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_84</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_84</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_85</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_85</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_83" sourceRef="TP.Draft" targetRef="TP.Send" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_85" sourceRef="TP.Recv" targetRef="TP.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Secretariat" name="Approve a Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.2, XI.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="Secretariat.Lane" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)">
        <bpmn:documentation>Administers the GDHCN and oversees the Onboarding Process. Framework V.1, V.4, VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.Advise</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.Annex</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.Publish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.No</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TS.EndNo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="TS.Start" name="Proposal received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_86</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="TS.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TS.Advise" name="Review the proposal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3. The Secretariat may convene Advisory Committees to support the evolution of Trust Domains (VI.3, X).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_86</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_87</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="TS.Ok" name="Approved?" default="Flow_TS_ok_yes">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3: the GDHCN operationalizes Trust Domains approved by the Secretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_87</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TS_ok_yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_90</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TS.Annex" name="Adopt the Trust Domain as an Annex">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.2, XI.1: the technical specifications become an Annex. Output: a TrustDomain instance.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TS_ok_yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_88</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TS.Publish" name="Publish and notify the representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework XI.2: published on the GDHCN website and sent to the Legal, Technical and Business Representatives; in effect from the date of notice.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_88</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_89</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TS.No" name="Inform the proposers">
      <bpmn:documentation>The proposal is not approved.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_90</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_91</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="TS.End" name="Trust Domain in effect">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_89</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="TS.EndNo" name="Proposal declined">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_91</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_86" sourceRef="TS.Start" targetRef="TS.Advise" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_87" sourceRef="TS.Advise" targetRef="TS.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TS_ok_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="TS.Ok" targetRef="TS.Annex" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_88" sourceRef="TS.Annex" targetRef="TS.Publish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_89" sourceRef="TS.Publish" targetRef="TS.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_90" name="no" sourceRef="TS.Ok" targetRef="TS.No" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_91" sourceRef="TS.No" targetRef="TS.EndNo" />
  </bpmn:process>
